evidence_policy.claim_scope: Authorial testcase observations supplement the managed hard-gate review; they create no requester-owned locks or acceptance.

stages_to_report_separately: actual new-source exposure by query/CID/RID/source hash

gates.pass_condition: The generated woman visibly follows the supplied facial appearance and short dark bob with light separated fringe. Compare the actual face and hair silhouette; resemblance is appearance guidance, not proof of real identity.
gates.fail_if: Face too small or turned away to assess, materially changed face, or long/incompatible hair.

gates.pass_condition: The person, medical records interface and clinical circulation are visibly part of the same hospital setting. A generic office counter alone does not pass.

The woman and empty transparent sleeve are on one side of a closed glass/transfer boundary; the separate chart is visible on the other side, inaccessible to her in that view. All components and their separation must be visible together.

An adjacent hospital exit has a visible closed seam and a steel bolt that actually spans that seam, while remaining spatially connected to the woman's waiting position. A red light or door-shaped rectangle alone cannot prove a locked exit.
Both relevant hands visibly belong to the woman; the sleeve-holding hand and hatch-resting fingertips have coherent reach and separate endpoints on the patient side.

Before reading intensity labels or prompt explanation, describe the visible scene. A credible threat to agency should arise from medical care/record control, human response and barriers, rather than from a generic gloomy color grade alone.

Only if a new integrated source contributes to the final: preserve its actual CID/RID/hash, complete source review, exact final phrase and visibly corresponding pixel region. Each selected relation requires all components; source exposure or a literal phrase alone is insufficient.
gates.when_no_source_selected: Report NOT_ADOPTED with candidate-specific reason; do not claim data-caused pixel success.

claim_limits: This is a fictional scene; appearance does not prove the reference person's real health, biography, mental state or consent.
A saved-pixel PASS does not establish requester preference.
A source not returned by the actual query cannot be reported as exposed.
Technical prompt/runtime audit PASS is distinct from pixels.
The chart portrait repetition and exact record identity may be unobservable at final scale; do not infer them from proximity alone.
